general.text: Contact the National Consumer Helpline (toll-free 1915, WhatsApp 8800001915) or file online via e-Jagriti (e-jagriti.gov.in). Free for claims up to ₹5 Lakhs.

flight_issue.name: DGCA via AirSewa
flight_issue.text: File a complaint on AirSewa (airsewa.gov.in) or call 1800-11-4477. Under DGCA rules, airlines must pay ₹5,000-₹20,000 compensation for cancellations and denied boarding.

telecom_issue.name: TRAI Appellate Authority
telecom_issue.text: Register DND complaints via SMS to 1909 or TRAI DND app. Escalate to the telco's Appellate Authority if unresolved within 30 days.

payment_dispute.name: RBI Integrated Ombudsman
payment_dispute.text: File at cms.rbi.org.in or call 14448. RBI Ombudsman can award up to ₹20 Lakh compensation. UPI reversals must happen within T+1 day (₹100/day penalty for delay).

banking_dispute.name: RBI Integrated Ombudsman
banking_dispute.text: File at cms.rbi.org.in or call 14448. Under RBI rules, recovery agents cannot call before 8 AM or after 7 PM. Failed ATM transactions must be reversed within T+5 days.

insurance_claim.name: IRDAI via Bima Bharosa
insurance_claim.text: File at bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in. Insurance Ombudsman handles claims up to ₹50 Lakh. Awards are binding on the insurer.

food_delivery_issue.name: FSSAI Food Safety
food_delivery_issue.text: Report food safety issues to FSSAI. Under FSSA 2006, both the restaurant and delivery platform are liable for unsafe food.

ride_hailing_issue.name: State Transport Authority
ride_hailing_issue.text: Under MoRTH guidelines, surge is capped at 1.5x base fare. Drivers cannot charge extra cash. File with your city's Regional Transport Office (RTO).

hotel_booking_issue.name: CCPA / Consumer Forum
hotel_booking_issue.text: Under CCPA 2022 guidelines, hotel service charges are VOLUNTARY and cannot be forced. Denied check-in on a confirmed booking is actionable deficiency.

edtech_refund.name: CCPA / Consumer Forum
edtech_refund.text: Under CCPA 2024 guidelines, coaching institutes cannot claim '100% selection' or 'guaranteed jobs'. 'No refund' policies have been declared void by the Supreme Court.

defective_product.right: Refusing refund for defective goods is an Unfair Trade Practice
Sellers cannot refuse returns if goods are defective, deficient, or differ from description
Product manufacturer, service provider, and seller are all liable for harm from defective products

delayed_delivery.right: Platform cannot charge cancellation fees unless it pays equal compensation when it cancels
Late delivery beyond promised date is a deficiency of service

subscription_cancel.right: Subscription Trap is illegal — cancellation must be as easy as subscribing
Non-refundable clauses when service is not rendered are an Unfair Trade Practice

food_delivery_issue.right: Both restaurant and aggregator are liable for unsafe food
Compensation for illness caused by unhygienic or contaminated food
Drip pricing (hidden platform/rain/handling fees) and basket sneaking (auto-adding tips) are illegal

flight_issue.law: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV
flight_issue.right: Denied boarding: ₹5,000-₹20,000 compensation. Flight cancelled <24h: alternate flight or refund + cash compensation
100% refund of all taxes (UDF, PSF) on any cancelled ticket, even non-refundable

flight_issue.law: Supreme Court (Pravasi Legal Cell v. UOI, 2020)
flight_issue.right: Airlines cannot force credit shells — must give direct refunds

ride_hailing_issue.right: Surge capped at 1.5x base fare. AC is mandatory without surcharge. Driver cancellation penalty: 10% (max ₹100)
Forcing refund as wallet credits is anti-consumer

payment_dispute.right: UPI/IMPS reversal within T+1 day. ₹100/day penalty for delay, credited automatically
Zero liability if fraud reported within 3 working days. Limited liability (₹5,000-₹25,000) if reported within 4-7 days

telecom_issue.right: Two-tier redressal: Customer Care → Appellate Authority (must decide within 30 days)
Unauthorized VAS (Value Added Services) must be refunded within 24 hours
Porting must complete within 3-5 working days. Invalid rejection: ₹10,000 penalty on telco

insurance_claim.right: 30-day free-look period. Cashless authorization within 1 hour. Hospital discharge approval within 3 hours
Life insurance cannot be repudiated after 3 years from issuance
Ombudsman handles claims up to ₹50 Lakh. Award is binding on insurer

banking_dispute.right: Recovery agents cannot call before 8 AM or after 7 PM, or contact unauthorized persons
ATM failure reversal within T+5 days. ₹100/day penalty for delay
Can award up to ₹20 Lakh for loss + ₹1 Lakh for harassment

edtech_refund.right: Ban on claims like '100% selection' or 'guaranteed job'. Mandatory disclosure of course terms
'Fee once paid not refunded' is NULL AND VOID. Institutes can only retain pro-rata fees for classes attended
Mandatory cooling-off period (min 3 days) to exit education loan without penalty

hotel_booking_issue.right: Service charge is VOLUNTARY. No hotel or restaurant can force it into the bill
Denied check-in on confirmed booking: compensation must cover alternative accommodation
Fake scarcity ('Only 1 room left!') and drip pricing (hidden resort fees) are illegal

wrong_item_delivered.right: Cannot refuse returns if goods differ from description
Delivering wrong items is an Unfair Trade Practice

ticket_booking_issue.right: Non-refundable clauses when event is cancelled are an Unfair Trade Practice
Basket sneaking (auto-ticking donations) and false urgency (fake countdown timers) are illegal

grocery_delivery_issue.right: Must display nutritional info, veg/non-veg logo, allergen details, and minimum remaining shelf life
Drip pricing (hidden handling/surge/small-cart fees) is illegal

health_pharma_issue.right: Schedule H and X drugs cannot be sold without valid prescription
E-pharmacies are liable for dispensing wrong drugs or expired medicines

furniture_delivery_issue.right: Platform cannot disclaim return responsibility for broken/damaged/delayed goods
Mandatory declaration of country of origin, manufacturer details, dimensions

counterfeit_product.right: Selling counterfeit goods is a serious Unfair Trade Practice
Sellers must state authentic country of origin and manufacturer address

seller_cancelled_order.right: Platform cannot charge cancellation fees unless it pays equal compensation when it cancels
Unilateral cancellation after accepting payment is an Unfair Trade Practice

train_issue.right: TDR (Ticket Deposit Receipt) must be filed within prescribed time for refund
AC failure, delayed trains (>3 hours), or diverted routes are actionable deficiency of service
